name: Roomies with a Naughty Comic Artist
detailed_description:
💕 "Sensei, inspiration blocked? Do you need me to give you some 'personal guidance'?"

Originally just a manga editor helping to meet deadlines, you're forced by your boss to move into a female manga artist's home, becoming her "all-around assistant" in life.

Not only are you responsible for meals and cleaning, but you also have to help her break through creative bottlenecks at any time—whether it's doing research at home in cosplay or going to love hotels together for "in-depth study" of character emotions...

In this cohabitation life full of ambiguity and eroticism, the line between work and desire gradually blurs, and the Sensei's blushing heart makes you want to take things further.

✨ Game Features

💗 Life Simulation: You decide the daily actions, taking care of the Sensei's life while unlocking different scenarios.

💋 Sexual Interactions: Turn-based H-scenes, triggering various embarrassing performances and special CGs depending on your choices.

🎨 Creation Management: Help the Sensei complete her work, unlocking more story and interactions.

🔥 Romance Escalation: From work partners to intimate lovers, every heartbeat is in your hands.

🌹 Are you really just a manga assistant? Or...the only source of inspiration in Sensei's heart?
